[[File:Colchuck Lake.jpg|thumb|300px|right|Splish splosh.]]A '''lake''' is a [[biome]]. It is a large area covered with fairly deep [[water]]. Lakes can be filled with freshwater, saltwater or brackish water. Lakes have slopes leading into the water, making them ideal for learning how to swim in [[adventure mode]].

The settings you choose during [[World generation]] have a large impact on how many lakes will be formed. For example, a Large Island world will typically have many fewer lakes than a Large Region world.

There are six types of lakes, divided by climate and the salinity of the water. They are listed in the following table:

{| {{prettytable}}
|- style="background:#dddddd"
! style="background:#aaaaaa"|
! '''Freshwater''' !! '''Brackish water''' !! '''Saltwater'''
|-
! style="background:#dddddd"| '''Temperate'''
| Temperate freshwater lake || Temperate brackish lake || Temperate saltwater lake
|-
! style="background:#dddddd"| '''Tropical'''
| Tropical freshwater lake || Tropical brackish lake || Tropical saltwater lake
|}
